This condition runs in families (as with your uncle) and is characterized by reduced levels of von Willebrand factor, leading to prolonged bleeding time and a tendency to bruise easily. Management includes avoiding medications that impair platelet function (e.g., aspirin, NSAIDs) and using desmopressin (DDAVP) or von Willebrand factor concentrates for procedures or significant bleeding episodes.
